name: Thunder Bay wrecks, west
published: Wrecks on NOAA's electronic navigational charts. Thunder Bay is a National Marine Sanctuary with some of the best-preserved wrecks in the Great Lakes. Charted positions can be tens of metres off, so a find within 100 m of a charted wreck counts. Uncharted wrecks and debris are not in the key.
